parts.name: ListboxRoot
parts.description: The list itself, with `role="listbox"`: it holds the selection, moves focus between the options and shares the state with the parts inside it. Label it with `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`, or put it in a FieldRoot. With a `name`, or inside a FieldRoot, it renders hidden inputs beside the list so the value is submitted with its form.

props.name: value
props.description: The selected value: a string, or `null` for none; with `multiple`, a list of strings. Pass it with `onValueChange` to control the selection.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The value selected at first, when the selection isn't controlled: a string, or a list of strings with `multiple`. A form reset puts it back.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the new value: a string with single selection, a list of strings with `multiple`. It runs in a change of its own, so a handler that saves to a server doesn't hold the list.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Whether any number of options may be selected. A click, Space and Enter then toggle an option, Shift+click and Shift+Space select a range, and Ctrl/Cmd+A selects them all.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the list is disabled: no option can be selected or reached with Tab. A disabled FieldRoot around it disables it too.

props.name: required
props.description: Whether a value must be selected for the form to be valid.

props.name: name
props.description: The name the value is submitted under. With `multiple`, each selected value is submitted as its own entry. Inside a named FieldRoot, the field's name is used.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Which arrow keys move focus: Up and Down, or Left and Right.

props.name: loop
props.description: Whether the arrow keys wrap around at the ends.

props.name: selectionFollowsFocus
props.description: Single selection only: moving focus with the keyboard selects the option it reaches.

dataAttributes.name: data-dirty
dataAttributes.description: Present once the field's value has changed.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the list is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-filled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the field has a value.

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Present while the field has focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-invalid
dataAttributes.description: Present when the field is invalid.

dataAttributes.name: data-touched
dataAttributes.description: Present once the field has been focused and left.

dataAttributes.name: data-valid
dataAttributes.description: Present when the field is valid.

parts.name: ListboxItem
parts.description: An option, with `role="option"` and `aria-selected`. It takes real focus: style the focused option with `:focus-visible`. Its `tabindex` is written by the list, which keeps one option the Tab stop.

props.name: value
props.description: The value the option stands for: what is selected, reported and submitted.

props.name: label
props.default: the option's text, leaving out what is `aria-hidden` (an indicator)

props.name: disabled
props.description: Can't be selected, and the arrow keys and typeahead skip it.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the option, or the whole list, is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-label
dataAttributes.description: The `label` prop, when given: the text typeahead matches.

dataAttributes.name: data-selected
dataAttributes.description: Present while the option is selected.

parts.name: ListboxItemText
parts.description: The option's text, beside an indicator or other content. A plain `span`, for styling.

parts.name: ListboxItemIndicator
parts.description: Rendered while its option is selected, or always with `keepMounted`. It is hidden from assistive technology, which hears `aria-selected` instead.

props.name: keepMounted
props.description: Render it on every option, selected or not, and style the selected ones from `data-selected`: for a box that is filled when selected.

dataAttributes.name: data-selected
dataAttributes.description: Present while its option is selected.

parts.name: ListboxGroup
parts.description: A set of related options, with `role="group"`, named by the ListboxGroupLabel inside it. The arrow keys run through groups as one list.

parts.name: ListboxGroupLabel
parts.description: The visible name of its group: the group's `aria-labelledby` points at it.
